Panel.Title: Smart Trains
Panel.ButtonHint: Smart Trains: every train, whether it moves, and why it stands
Empty.City: There are no trains in this city.
ReasonHint.Boarding: The train stands at the platform until its departure time.
ReasonHint.LatePassengers: The departure time has passed. The train waits for passengers still walking to it, at most about ten minutes.
ReasonHint.TrainAhead: A train ahead stands on the track, or has reserved the track this train needs next.
ReasonHint.CrossingTrain: A train crosses this train's way at a switch or crossing.
ReasonHint.OncomingTrain: A train comes the other way on the same track.
ReasonHint.Obstacle: Something other than a train is in the way, e.g. a car on a level crossing.
ReasonHint.RoutePending: The game computes a new route for the train. It brakes until the route is there.
ReasonHint.Deadlock: Trains block each other in a circle. The game removes one of them.
ReasonHint.Unknown: The game reports no cause for the stop.
DiagnoseHint: Writes this train, every train it waits for, and the track ahead of each to Logs/SmartTrains.log.
Removed.Hint: The game removes trains without a word when they block each other in a circle or find no route. Every such case since loading is listed here and written to Logs/SmartTrains.log.
Removed.None: Since loading, the game has removed no train unplanned.
